Well played! Key factors in the win:
- Preserved potions until critical thresholds (healed at 20 HP).
- Kept attacking to maintain tempo and force opponent potion usage early.
- Used potion advantage to outlast in the damage race.
- Closed decisively when opponent hit 10 HP.

Final notes: In this fixed-damage setup, optimal play is usually to attack until you’d be killed next turn, then potion; this maximizes pressure and value from heals.
